budget_items.topic: Supplemental tax billing for new construction
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Eight supplemental bill notification letters were to be mailed to owners whose new-construction building values rose over fifty percent; the letter explains a prorated supplemental tax on top of the FY2019 bill, but no dollar figures are printed (the value and tax fields are blank).
budget_items.quote: eight (8) supplemental bill notification letters will be mailed tomorrow to property owners

budget_items.what_was_recorded: A rollback tax was collected on the Chapter 61B partial release of 35.07 acres.
budget_items.quote: a rollback tax of $6,445.84 was collected on april 18, 2019 in the amount of $6,445.84.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Louise reported the total exemption amount granted across 140 statutory exemption applications.
budget_items.quote: louise reported that the total exemption amount granted is $88,586.19 for 140 statutory exemption applications.

budget_items.topic: CAMA/Assessing software contract and early-termination fees
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Town Counsel's review found the contract cannot be terminated now; early-termination fees apply through the second contract year, so the board sought further advice.
budget_items.quote: the contract states that through the second year of the contract there are fees associated with early termination

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The owner's representative reported a purchase and sale agreement accepted for the property; the board agreed to a settlement valuation below that price.
budget_items.quote: a purchase & sale agreement has been accepted for the property in the amount of $900,000.
